w10_T4_005636: A coach company records every journey in minutes and only turns the totals into hours for its printed timetable. On Tuesday a driver waited 20 minutes at each of the 4 loading bays, and the office added those waits into one figure. That figure was split equally between the 2 drivers who shared the shift, and Ellie took her share. Ellie's own driving added 29 minutes to her share. A short cut on the way back saved her 1 minute. The company owns 15 coaches. How many minutes does Ellie's total come to?
w10_T4_005638: A juice kiosk counts its tips in cents and only changes them into dollars on Sunday. The tip jar held 20 cents when the kiosk opened on Friday morning. During the morning customers dropped in 26 cents and then 6 cents. At lunchtime a large group left 61 cents in the jar. In the afternoon the owner took 38 cents out to buy straws, and in the evening the staff removed 72 cents to share between them. The kiosk served 84 customers that day. How many cents are left in the tip jar?
w10_T4_005639: A tiling firm records its weights in kilograms although its invoices are written in tonnes. On Monday morning each of the 9 racks in the yard held 96 tiles, and 176 of those tiles were found cracked and taken away before noon. Every tile that was left weighs 5 kilograms. In the afternoon 2287 kilograms of tiles were loaded onto a lorry and driven off. In the evening a supplier dropped off 7 kilograms of spare tiles. The rest was divided equally among 4 vans for the next morning, and Ravi drove one of them while his colleague Sanjay set off with a lighter load of his own. How many kilograms of tiles are in Ravi's van?
w10_T4_005642: A cheese shop had 78 rounds of cheese in the cold room, and a farm delivered 37 more. All the rounds were shared equally among the shop's 5 counters, and Dario took charge of the counter by the window. He then carried 13 more rounds up from the cold room, and 26 rounds from his counter were sold during the day. Each round still on his counter is cut into 6 wedges for the evening tasting. A dozen candles are lit on that counter every evening. How many wedges will Dario's counter have?
w10_T4_005645: A school print room measures paper in sheets but writes its orders in reams, converting one into the other by hand. On Monday 132 blank booklets were shared equally among the 3 printing machines. Each booklet that a machine received was printed with 9 pages. The finished pages were gathered and split equally into 3 delivery stacks. Every page in a single stack was then photocopied 8 times for the year group, and those copies were shared equally among the 3 form classes. Mr Hale handed out 194 copies to his own class, while Ms Ives kept a smaller set for hers. How many copies does Mr Hale still have?
w10_T4_005646: A stationery warehouse stores pens in 8 aisles, and on Monday each aisle held 175 boxes. A supplier delivered 8 more boxes that afternoon. Over the week 1144 boxes were sent out to schools. On Friday a cancelled order brought 67 boxes back to the warehouse. How many boxes are in the warehouse now?
w10_T4_005648: A bottling plant records its volumes in litres though the old tanks are still marked in gallons. Early on Monday each of the 5 filling lines packed 158 crates, and every crate holds 3 bottles. During the morning a small extra line added 77 more bottles to the stack. In the afternoon 1666 bottles went out to supermarkets. In the evening another 756 bottles were loaded onto a night lorry. The plant employs 62 people. How many bottles are left at the plant?
w10_T4_005649: On Monday morning a garden centre had 164 tulip bulbs in its display bin. Before lunch a delivery added 19 bulbs, and in the early afternoon a second delivery added 71 more. Later that afternoon 83 bulbs were sold to customers. In the evening the manager decided the display looked thin and made it 4 times as large by bringing bulbs up from the cellar. Just before closing a customer returned 21 bulbs to the bin. How many bulbs are in the display bin now?
w10_T4_005650: Leon's farm had 155 crates of apples in the barn at the start of the week, and a pick on Tuesday added 74 more. He sold 34 crates at the gate and delivered 186 crates to a village shop. Each crate still in the barn holds 5 baskets of apples. On Friday 24 of those baskets were given to the school. Leon's neighbour Greta keeps fewer crates in her barn than Leon does, and her orchard covers 12 hectares. How many baskets are in Leon's barn now?
w10_T4_005653: On Monday morning a printing shop had 136 posters in each of its 8 storage tubes. During the morning a designer added 25 loose posters to the same pile. In the afternoon the whole pile was shared equally among the shop's 3 branches, and Julia took the share for the branch on Mill Road. That evening a client returned 74 posters to Mill Road. Julia sold more posters that week than her colleague Ben did, and the shop van holds 900 posters. How many posters are at the Mill Road branch?
w10_T4_005655: On Saturday morning a village bakery had 76 jars of jam on its shelf. Before noon a coach party bought 70 of them. In the afternoon the baker boiled a fresh batch and doubled the number of jars standing on the shelf. Later that afternoon 9 jars were sold to a hotel. In the evening a farm delivered 79 new jars for the same shelf. How many jars of jam are on the shelf at the end of the day?
w10_T4_005658: A stadium's programme sellers count their takings in cents and only work them out in dollars after the match. Before the game Hugo had 120 programmes on each of his 5 trolleys. A late print run gave him 45 more, and then 32 were spoiled by rain and thrown away. Every programme he still has carries 3 vouchers inside it. Hugo sold more programmes that afternoon than his colleague Petra did. How many vouchers does Hugo have?
w10_T4_005660: Sara keeps her revision log in minutes, though her tutor prefers to talk about it in hours. On Monday morning the log stood at 67 minutes, and she added 30 minutes before breakfast. She then crossed off 32 minutes that she had written down twice by mistake. During the afternoon she added 39 minutes, then 68 minutes, and in the early evening another 48 minutes. Late that night she removed 33 minutes she had spent chatting rather than working. How many minutes does Sara's log show now?
w10_T4_005661: A campsite records its water in litres although the tank gauge is still marked in gallons. On Monday morning each of the 7 cabins was issued 136 litres of water from the store. During the day a spare barrel added 27 litres to the campsite's supply. By the afternoon 769 litres had been used for showers and cooking. In the evening a tanker arrived and doubled the amount of water still on the site. How many litres of water are on the site now?
w10_T4_005671: A cannery began the day with 170 empty barrels in the yard. 7 barrels were found cracked, and 43 more were sent to another site. Each barrel that stayed holds 4 sacks, and every sack holds 7 kilograms of beans. All of the beans were then poured equally into 4 silos. A farmer added a dozen kilograms of beans to one of those silos. How many kilograms of beans are in that silo?
w10_T4_005673: A theatre counts its interval sales in cents and totals them in dollars at the end of the night. There were 92 boxes of chocolates in the store, and 1 box was damaged and thrown out. Each remaining box holds 4 bags, and 272 bags were sold before the interval. Every bag still in the store holds 6 chocolates. A staff member then tipped 44 loose chocolates into the store as well. A dozen ushers work in the theatre each night. How many chocolates are in the store?
w10_T4_005674: A tree nursery had 180 saplings growing in its field, and 26 of them died over the winter. Each surviving sapling was trimmed into 4 cuttings and moved to the propagation shed. During the spring 261 cuttings were sold to a council. A garden club then donated 71 cuttings to the shed. The nursery keeps a dozen wheelbarrows in the yard, and its field measures 35 metres across. How many cuttings are in the shed now?
w10_T4_005680: On Monday morning a music shop had 181 sheets of music in its rack, and a customer donated 5 more before lunch. In the afternoon the shop's copier doubled the number of sheets in the rack. That evening the owner replaced everything in the rack with 3 copies of each sheet that had been in it. On Tuesday 31 sheets were sold from the rack, and on Wednesday 10 new sheets were added to it. On Thursday evening 561 sheets were sent to a school choir. How many sheets of music are in the rack now?
w10_T4_005681: On Friday morning Elena's food bank had 109 tins on its shelf. Before lunch 54 tins were given out to families, and a visitor took 1 more tin early in the afternoon. Later that afternoon a supermarket delivered 76 tins. In the evening a school collection brought 28 tins, and a neighbour dropped off 16 more just before closing. Elena's shelf held more tins that day than her colleague Marcus had on his. How many tins are on Elena's shelf?
w10_T4_005683: A cycling club logs every ride in minutes and prints the season total in hours. Priya's log began the month at 64 minutes. She added 67 minutes on her first ride, 78 minutes on her second and 63 minutes on her third. The club then removed 94 minutes that had been entered twice by mistake. Her last ride of the month added 46 minutes. Priya's log is longer this month than her friend Noor's log. How many minutes does Priya's log show?
w10_T4_005684: A jam factory had 138 crates of fruit in the yard, and a farm brought 78 more. Each crate was emptied into 6 buckets. The buckets were shared equally among the factory's 6 kitchens, and Rosa took charge of one kitchen. She then received 45 more buckets from the yard, and later 78 more were carried in to her. A dozen aprons hang by her kitchen door. How many buckets are in Rosa's kitchen?
w10_T4_005690: A repair shop notes its jobs in minutes and bills them in hours. On Monday Farid's job list stood at 123 minutes of work, and two new bookings added 63 minutes and then 36 minutes. During the week 215 minutes of that work were finished and crossed off. A customer then booked a job worth 50 minutes. Farid has more minutes booked than his colleague Yusuf does, and the shop has 4 work bays. How many minutes of work are on Farid's list?
w10_T4_005695: On Saturday morning Tomas picked 88 apples from his tree, and by mid-morning he had picked 10 more. At noon he gave half of them to his sister Ines and kept the rest, so that the two of them had equal amounts. In the afternoon a neighbour gave Tomas 55 apples from her own tree. In the evening Tomas packed everything he had into 4 equal baskets for the market and loaded one basket into his car. How many apples are in the basket in Tomas's car?
w10_T4_005698: A pottery studio had 64 blocks of clay in its store. 55 blocks were used up in a school workshop. Each block that remained was rolled into 9 small pots. A visiting artist then brought 57 finished pots to the store, and 78 pots were sold at the weekend market. The pots that were left were packed equally into 6 crates for a craft fair. The studio has 3 kilns. How many pots are in one of those crates?
w10_T4_005703: A stadium kiosk had 221 trays of snacks in each of its 8 storerooms. During the match 473 trays were carried out to the stands. A late delivery then brought 48 more trays. Each tray still in the storerooms holds 8 packets of crisps. All of the packets were shared equally among the 4 kiosks for the next match. A dozen staff work in each kiosk. How many packets does one kiosk have?
